{{Top|canon=Ore freighter}}
An '''ore hauler''' was a starship smaller than a [[Tsukkian water freighter]]. The [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForce]] elite unit [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] had two of these.<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>

Three [[Color/Legends|gray]]-painted, open&ndash;[[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] ore haulers, with beds a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] height by four nose&ndash;to&ndash;tail [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] in size and repulsor fields extending several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] outwards, were kept on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Folor]] in the [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]]. Brought there in Folor's time as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony, they continued to be maintained following the establishment of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Folor Base|base]], and were raced across the moon's surface by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]] during the training period of [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
